facts.text: The hotel is in the Business Bay district along Dubai Water Canal.
facts.excerpt: Anchored in the dynamic Business Bay district along Dubai Water Canal, JW Marriott Marquis Dubai continues to shape the future of luxury hospitality in the region.

facts.text: The hotel comprises two towers beside the Dubai Water Canal.
facts.excerpt: Comprising two iconic towers, the JW Marriott Marquis Dubai is centrally located beside the Dubai Water Canal.

facts.text: The hotel is located near Dubai Metro, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, DIFC and Sheikh Zayed Road.
facts.excerpt: Ideally located near Dubai Metro, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Dubai International Airport, DIFC and Sheikh Zayed Road

facts.text: Rooms and family suites have skyline views, deluxe bedding and marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: offers 1,608 5-star hotel rooms and family suites with stunning skyline views, deluxe bedding, marble bathrooms and 24-hour room service

facts.text: Deluxe guest rooms have separate shower and bath facilities.
facts.excerpt: our 44 sqm Deluxe guest rooms provide a king or twin bed arrangement, a separate shower and bath facilities, and complimentary high-speed Internet among many other features.

facts.text: The duplex penthouses are on the top floors of both towers, with a separate living area, master and guest bedrooms, a dining area, views of the Arabian Gulf and Executive Lounge access.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury duplex penthouses are located on the top floors of both towers. They feature a separate living area, master and guest bedrooms, dining area, breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the access to our Executive Lounge.

facts.text: Saray Spa draws inspiration from the historic caravanserais along the old silk trade routes.
facts.excerpt: True to its name and drawing inspiration from the historic Caravanserais located along the silk trade routes of old, Saray Spa offers a personal experience of restoration and renewal

facts.text: Saray Spa has private hammam rooms, spa suites and separate men's and women's spa lounges.
facts.excerpt: Saray Spa offers 17 treatment rooms, two private hammam rooms, two spa suites, and separate men's and women's spa lounges.

facts.text: The outdoor pool has a swim-up bar, a children's pool and a plunge pool.
facts.excerpt:

facts.text: BodyBase is a boutique reformer studio at the hotel offering BaseGym and BaseFlow classes.
facts.excerpt: Step into BodyBase at JW Marriott Marquis Dubai, a boutique reformer studio born in Europe, powered by innovation, and curated for those who move with purpose. Choose between BaseGym for high-intensity beats or BaseFlow for mindful movement.

facts.text: Club Marquis is the hotel's health club, with access free for all hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Access is free for all hotel guests.

facts.text: Garden by Kitchen6 presents cuisines from around the world across six interactive live-cooking stations.
facts.excerpt: chefs present cuisines from around the world across six interactive live-cooking stations, from Asian woks and Middle Eastern grills to European breads and Indian tandoors.

facts.text: The Vault bar offers live entertainment and city views.
facts.excerpt: Discover live entertainment, crafted beverages and unrivaled city views from the elegant Vault bar

facts.text: The Executive Lounge is on the 37th floor of Tower B.
Valet parking is complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: The nearest metro station is Business Bay Metro Station on the Red Line.
facts.excerpt: Business Bay Metro Station Red Line

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Dubai.

facts.text: The hotel has more than 15 restaurants, bars and lounges.
facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Dubai presents an inspiring collection of more than 15 award-winning restaurants, bars and lounges in Business Bay.
